_help: Picture settings. Re-read on every picture. The picture model's file names (unet, clip, vae) are chosen in ~/.sera/models.json under "image"; the files themselves live in image_gen/ComfyUI/models/{unet,clip,vae}.
negative: This greyscale unfinished sketch has bad proportions, is featureless and disfigured. It is a blurry ugly mess and with excessive gaussian blur. It is riddled with watermarks and signatures. Everything is smudged with leaking colors and nonsensical orientation of objects. Messy and abstract image filled with artifacts disrupt the coherency of the overall composition. The image has extreme chromatic abberations and inconsistent lighting. Dull, monochrome colors and countless artistic errors.
suffix: anatomically correct. highest quality. detailed. sharp focus.

discord._help: Pictures from Discord chats: !image <prompt>. Off until you switch it on (or send !image on). Who may draw or edit is set in access_config.json (or with !allow). Each non-owner waits cooldown_seconds between pictures and at most max_waiting are queued.

safety._help: What she won't draw (see image_safety.py). The under-18 rule is always on. enabled switches the categories below and the avoid list (!image safety on|off). fail_closed: if her model can't be asked, refuse instead of drawing unchecked. avoid: extra words added to every picture's avoid list while enabled. block_nudity: no nude or sexual pictures at all (deliberately edited here, not by command).

edit._help: Editing a picture from an instruction (!image edit). ceiling_mb: the edit is stopped if the card's used memory passes it (the card has 12288 MiB). default: which model when none is named. (Qwen-Image-Edit was tried and removed: Q4 made anatomy errors.) megapixels (per model): the size edits are made at by default. min_megapixels / max_megapixels: the range a request may ask for (bigger = sharper but slower and more graphics memory; the ceiling_mb check still applies). enlarge_small: a result whose long side is under 1024 pixels (a small megapixels size) is enlarged with hard pixel edges, so chunky pixel art stays crisp instead of blurry.

upscale._help: The upscaling step after an edit, or when a picture is only to be enlarged. backend: 'seedvr2' (a diffusion transformer that looks at the whole picture; default) or 'swinir' (a faster, sharper-but-more-invented GAN model, the file named in 'model'). scale 1 = off. native_scale and 'model' are for swinir only. max_scale and max_output_megapixels cap what a request can ask for. default_scale is used when an edit names none; upscale_only_scale when a picture is only enlarged. color_correction (seedvr2): lab, wavelet, adain or none.
